home.title: Jana Nayagan
home.desc: Jana Nayagan (People's Hero) is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language political action thriller directed by H. Vinoth and starring Vijay, Pooja Hegde, and Bobby Deol. Billed as Vijay’s final film before his full-time political career, it is a high-octane drama centered on a clash of ideologies between a populist leader and an authoritarian, featuring intense action scenes, emotional drama, and a reported 3-hour-6-minute runtime.
